description: Notional and margin required for a forex position, converted to a given account currency via a live FX rate (same TrueFX/frankfurter.app source as workflow.run_forex_pip_value_live). Use when user asks "how much margin do I need in my account currency?" and the account currency differs from the pair's own quote currency. Returns everything workflow.run_forex_margin_required does, plus accountCurrency, notionalAccount, marginAccount, fxRate, fxSource, available (false + error if no rate could be found).

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"

name: workflow.run_forex_margin_required_live
